description: Log all file edits to a project-local audit file with timestamps. Records every Edit tool usage to .gemini/edit-log.txt for tracking changes across sessions. Requires jq.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs -I FILE sh -c 'echo "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S): Edit FILE" >> "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.gemini/edit-log.txt"'
